name: Leaping AI
long_description:
Leaping AI is the best platform to deploy voice and texting AI agents for customer service, lead qualification and appointment scheduling. We target mid-market and Enterprise companies and industries are: home remodeling, roofing, pay per call, travel, retail, health insurance, Medicare, health and real estate.

We automated contact centers employing >100 human agents and now handle their incoming customer support and appointment scheduling calls, end-to-end. All while maintaining 90% customer satisfaction score.

Pain points that we solve: missed calls, insufficient speed to lead, not enough call center resources, call center inefficiencies, agents not sticking to the script, etc.

At its core, we have a multi-channel outreach campaign feature, whereby our customers can call and text potential leads over an arbitrary time period. If end customers call or text back, the Leaping voice or text AI agent can autonomously schedule appointments and resolve service requests.

Some of our differentiating features: most-human like voice in the market, CRM integrations in place (Salesforce, Hubspot, MarketSharp, AccuLynx, JobNimbus, LeadPerfection, Google, etc.) and white-glove onboarding (in-person for larger accounts). Our AI agents can hold 100+ conversations at once, speak multiple languages and be equipped with company specific FAQ. Lastly, we have our own number health monitoring and DNC software.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer:
Home remodeling and roofing companies that we speak to almost always have one of the following pain points: missed calls, not fast speed to lead, insufficient lead follow ups, dropped leads, not enough staff, etc.

Leaping AI addresses these pain points with an AI voice and texting platform that allows call centers to run multi-threaded calling and texting campaigns over the span of several weeks. We automate both inbound and outbound calling.

launches.title: Leaping AI – Automate your complex call center with voice AI!
launches.tagline: Self-improving AI voice agents to replace your whole call center. At scale.
launches.body:
**TLDR**; Leaping AI creates voice agents for businesses with high call volumes (>100k calls a year). Our voice AI agents are human-like, handle complex workflows, and automate up to 70% of customer support calls while maintaining 90% customer satisfaction. They get better over time.

<https://youtu.be/VZMd2VZW8EA>

# **The Problem**

Running a call center with humans is expensive.

Current voice AI solutions are either outdated or developer focused. With our solution, we target medium to larger sized businesses that want to have a cutting-edge solution, yet don’t have significant developer resources and want an easy to use platform.

# **The Solution**

Our platform allows the deployment of powerful human-like voice AI agents for any customer support and sales support use case. There is a simple user interface to set up multi-stage agents with simple English prompt instructions for behavior and transitions. Agents can speak in multiple languages (English, German, Spanish, Arabic, etc.) and be plugged into your infrastructure with API connectors. All the calls are recorded and can be listened to and analyzed in our platform.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86840&key=user_uploads/1218980/f6b54cbc-0421-4256-9040-0a8b4cfdada1)

# **Our voice AI agents self-improve**

Previously, we spent hundreds of hours together with our clients on manually listening to / evaluating calls and testing new prompts. Now, the agent autonomously performs post-call analysis, changes itself and runs A/B tests to improve prompting! We are seeing real day-on-day improvement on the rate of call transfers to humans while being fully hands off!

# **Case studies**

We have been live with our product for a couple of months and currently power thousands of calls daily. 

Some success stories:

1. We are working with Hawesko, Germany’s largest wine merchant. They historically had >100 human agents and we are now taking 100% of incoming customer support calls for one of their brands (>1.000 calls per day). In select use cases such as wine purchasing, our voice AI agents have been able to autonomously conduct 70% of conversations without any human call transfer.
2. For another retailer, we ran an outbound campaign on around 1.000 leads that did not complete the onboarding process. Within a week, we were able to convert 30% of leads contacted. When this retailer did similar campaigns in the past with human agents, they achieved the same result, but it took them 5 weeks.
3. We are working with a Jamaican BPO call center that does Affordable Care Act (ACA) inbound / outbound pre-qualification calls. We are now doing >5.000 calls a day for them with our voice AI agents, taking over pre-qualification and handing over only pre-qualified customers to human agents – saving 1 minute per call on every call.

# **The team**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86840&key=user_uploads/1218980/bf93647d-42fa-45da-be1c-ce19c42595d9)

We are [Kevin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kevin-wu-452a6393/), [Arkadiy](https://www.linkedin.com/in/a-telegin/), and [Shraey](https://www.linkedin.com/in/shraeybhatia/) – we previously worked at Microsoft, BCG, and IBM Research and are now passionate about disrupting the contact center industry.

# **Our ask**

If your company has >10 call center agents or works with a BPO doing phone-based customer support and / or sales, we would love to see if our voice AI agents can help you.

Likewise, if you are connected to someone that might be interested in our solution, we would love to get connected.
